Message.MsgText: The Solution Name 'Solution Name' of the configuration 'file name' is not a valid file name. The configuration instance id and Solution Name will be changed to: 'Solution Name'.

Explanation.p: When a configuration has a defined Solution Name, the name used as the configuration instance id by the SyncWeave Server. The configuration id is used to store certain artifacts, such as system logs, on the file system of the SyncWeave Server. The Solution Name in the configuration file was not valid file name. The SyncWeave Server has modified the Solution Name internally so that it can be used as a configuration id.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a valid Solution Name in the configuration file.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure that no two configurations have the same Solution Names.

Message.MsgText: The SyncWeave Server detected the Solution Name 'Solution Name' from a client in the token 'token name'.

Message.MsgText: Solution Name 'name' of configuration 'file name' coincides with the name of file 'file name'.

Explanation.p: For security reasons, Solution Names are not allowed to coincide with names of existing files.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the Solution Name of the configuration is not the same as the path of an existing file.
